run_draw_figure_8: run the script to plot attention entropy across layers for different learning rates from wikitext2 results
run_plot_attention_entropy: run the script to generate a multi-subplot figure of attention entropy per layer saved as a PDF
run_load_and_aggregate_results: run the script to load two PyTorch result files, aggregate entropies and validation loss by learning rate
run_filter_by_num_layers: run the script to filter results to a fixed number of layers and compute average entropy per learning rate
run_print_val_loss_summary: run the script to print a DataFrame summarizing minimum validation loss per learning rate and layer count
